name: production boundary: an npm option whose value may hide the exec subcommand keeps its -c payload unread and denied

source.assertion:
assert_equals "an npm option whose value may hide the exec subcommand keeps its -c payload unread and denied" \
  "deny" "$(verdict_for \"npm --loglevel silent exec -c 'vercel --prod'\")"

contains: past what the production boundary can read
